2390-6191-8335.description:
Gain life.
Neelix triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4770-5301-6723-7060.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

856-5632-5776-6495.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.

856-5632-5776-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

813-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1349-4050-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-4050-6854.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter, adding one mana of any color.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-851-1308-3129-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2459-2928-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.

2459-2928-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5086-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2438-5170-6132-7452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

140-4417-7433.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

2105-3480-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

3967-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

240-4885-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2981-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
2981-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

2034-2557-2919-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1409-5184-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
You control at least two Doctors.
11-1927-6070-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting and returning the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

141-3505-6798.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.

Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

141-3967-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3967-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

101-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Vampire Charmseeker.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
101-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker, causing you to mill cards equal to Vampire Charmseeker's power.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3995-5457-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3995-5457-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2254-4125-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
2254-4125-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}.
Shipwreck Dowser's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Shipwreck Dowser's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Shipwreck Dowser's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1430-2607-2682.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1430-2607-2682.description:

When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Mirror Image trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1874-2966-3253-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
1874-2966-3253-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

674-1308-2206-4231-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1479-2907-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-2907-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and each Scute Swarm trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating either a 1/1 Insect creature token or a token copy of Scute Swarm.
The creature token enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and each Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

222-3433-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-3433-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Hornet Queen and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hornet Queen and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing two Insects, Hornet Queen and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Tree of Tales by tapping it, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Tree of Tales.
Repeat.

The nontoken creature enters the battlefield, triggering Blessed Sanctuary, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Unicorn tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

122-2034-2324-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver, adding {C}{C}.
Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding {C}{C}.
Proper Burial and Junji trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Junji's toughness.
Resolve the Junji trigger, causing you to lose 2 life and to put Phyrexian Delver from your graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, causing you to return Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose five life.
Repeat.

1267-3742.notablePrerequisites:
Phantom Steed does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.

Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Medomai that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with the Medomai token, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1769-2201-3300-4924.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Meathook Massacre triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1638-1887-2060.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Flameshadow Conjuring.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{R}.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, paying {R} to create a copy of Palinchron.
 The Palinchron copy enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate the non-token Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
